disputable.why: His E and R drag a champion along with him rather than toward him. It fits 'forcibly moves an enemy' and was approved in L6, but some players call it a carry, not a pull.
Shockwave launches enemies toward the Ball, not toward Orianna. It fits 'toward a point' (L7), but players who think of a pull as a hook will argue.
Fear Beyond Death only reels the target in on the recast, after they fall below the execute threshold.

fun.why: Everyone gets Blitzcrank and Thresh at once, the hook supports follow, and then there's a long tail of pulls hidden in fighters' and mages' kits (Swain, Aatrox, Hwei, Zaahen) that few players name all of.

champion:Blitzcrank.why: Rocket Grab is the defining pull in the game.

champion:Thresh.why: Death Sentence is the other textbook hook.

champion:Pyke.why: Bone Skewer is a well-known hook.

champion:Nautilus.why: Dredge Line is a classic hook, though it also pulls Nautilus.

champion:Darius.why: Apprehend is a famous pull on a top laner.

champion:Sett.why: Facebreaker pulling both sides together is memorable.

champion:Urgot.why: The ult reel-in is iconic for players who've been caught by it.

champion:Mordekaiser.why: Death's Grasp is a well-known pull among top laners.

champion:Rell.why: Magnet Storm is a big pull in teamfights, but Rell is less played.

champion:Diana.why: Moonfall pulls enemies in; players often remember it as a slow.

champion:Yone.why: Fate Sealed pulls enemies in, but players remember the blink.

champion:KSante.why: The stacked Q pull is known to top laners only.

champion:Swain.why: Nevermove's root-then-pull is a well-known combo, but players think of it as a root first.

champion:Kled.why: Beartrap on a Rope yanks the target, but few players remember it.

champion:Aatrox.why: Infernal Chains pull back players who don't escape; easy to forget.

champion:Orianna.why: Shockwave's pull to the Ball is known, but rarely thought of as a pull.

champion:AurelionSol.why: The black hole drags enemies; few players think of it.

champion:Skarner.why: The rework drags enemies along; it's new, and players think of it as a suppress.

champion:Hwei.why: Crushing Maw is one of many spells in his kit; few players recall it.

champion:Nilah.why: The pull at the end of her ult is easy to miss.

champion:Zaahen.why: A new champion whose kit few players know yet.

tooClever.why: Players reach for Shockwave as the clever non-hook answer.

gemCandidates.why: The 'oh, of course, the root-then-pull!' answer. Plenty of players know the combo but don't file it as a pull.
Everyone has been dragged back by Infernal Chains; few remember it here.
Beartrap on a Rope is a satisfying deep-ish cut that Kled and top-lane players get.
